title: Harlow student system upgrade status
brief: Harlow University's IT office needs a status page for the student information system upgrade, as of 2026-10-16, for the steering committee, with go-live on 2027-01-11 ahead of spring registration. Overall the project is amber. Budget: 2.6 million dollars approved, 1.74 million spent (66.9 percent), forecast at completion 2.78 million, which is 0.18 million over. Under "Milestones", the five phases with percent complete and status: Data cleanup, 100, done; System configuration, 85, green; Integration testing, 40, amber; User training, 10, green; Cutover rehearsal, 0, planned for 2026-12-07. Under "Risks", three, with owner and severity: the financial aid integration is failing 14 of 60 test cases, Beatrice Lindgren, high; registrar staff have only 55 of the 120 planned training seats confirmed, Omar Faraj, medium; a freeze on course catalog changes must begin by 2026-11-20 and 3 departments have not agreed, Greta Nilsson, medium. Under "Decision needed": whether to approve 0.18 million dollars of extra vendor support through 2027-01-31, or move go-live to 2027-02-15, which would miss the first week of spring registration. Sections: "At a glance", "Milestones", "Risks" and "Decision needed".

edit.request: Integration testing is now 55 percent complete and the financial aid integration is failing only 6 of 60 test cases.
